feeds.title: Terpsichore
feeds.description: Terpsichore is the muse of dance this account is about every kind of dance. It is about performances and participating in dance. Get dance news from around the UK and the rest of the World. It covers Ballet reviews, classes and much more.

feeds.title: Ballet Fusion
feeds.description: Ballet Fusion Blog. Find out about adult ballet fitness, what to wear to adult ballet, and ballet principles & techniques to strengthen the entire body. Ballet Fusion is an adult ballet training program developed by Rhea Sheedy.

feeds.title: Ballet Position Blog
feeds.description: An information resource and forum for young dancers on ballet companies in the UK, continental Europe, and North America.

feeds.title: British Ballet Now & Then
feeds.description: Thoughts on British Ballet past and present. We are lecturers in dance history and we like a bit of ballet. This blog has been set up to open a discussion of what is happening in British ballet right now and how these events connect with the past.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Ballet
feeds.description: Get the latest news, updates, reviews, and features on Ballet from The Guardian the world's leading liberal voice.

feeds.title: The Wonderful World of Dance
feeds.description: The Wonderful World of Dance is the most beautiful dance magazine in the world, covering ballet, dance, contemporary dance, flamenco, hip hop, dance blogs, dancewear, fashion, beauty, ballet blogs, reviews, interviews, features from dancers, choreographers, artistic directors, and ballet dancers.

feeds.title: Breaking Ballet Blog
feeds.description: Breaking Ballet is a unique ballet-inspired workout program for busy women. The blog covers Ballet workouts to strengthen your body, healthy eating advice, tips on techniques, and guidance from Sarah Aspinall.

feeds.title: Ballet News
feeds.description: Ballet News is a professionally written website and covers professional ballet companies & vocational schools around the world. You'll find interviews, reviews, backstage, rehearsal and performance photographs, latest news updates, video clips, competitions, Ballet Business, From Student to Star and Cupcakes & Conversation, plus a whole lot more.
